messages:
Priya Nair: Quick announcement - we're starting a Q3 reforecast and making a small change to the vendor approval flow. Please read and action.
Ethan Cole: TL;DR: confirm headcount & committed spend by EOD Fri (5pm PT). New PO threshold and onboarding steps below.
Priya Nair: Key dates: submit budget updates in the shared sheet by Friday 5pm PT. Procurement will close intake next Mon for finalization.
Samir Patel: Got it. Is this just for new vendors or renewals too?
Priya Nair: Both. Anything > $5,000 (cumulative annual spend) now needs a formal PO + vendor risk sign-off. Renewals that push a vendor over that threshold need re-approval.
Lina Gomez: For startups we're negotiating with, can solutions teams start the procurement questionnaire or does finance do that?
Priya Nair: Teams should start the onboarding questionnaire (link below) and attach initial SOW/quote. Finance will pick up the security/vendor risk steps. Link: https://redwood.company/confluence/finance/vendor-onboarding
Ethan Cole: New approval flow (short): 1) Manager approval in the form 2) Procurement triage 3) Finance sign-off for > $5k. Expect 7-10 biz days for onboarding once form + docs are complete.
Priya Nair: Temporary card guidance: corporate card purchases under $500 still OK without PO. Anything $500-$5k requires manager/PO request. For anything urgent outside hours, ping me or Ethan.
Samir Patel: If a purchase is time-sensitive and vendor onboarding would delay us, is there an emergency path?
Priya Nair: Yes - emergency purchases require 2 manager approvals + explicit Finance email sign-off. We'll log it and follow up with retrospective PO. Use `#procurement-emergencies` and cc finance@redwood.com.
Lina Gomez: PO template? Do we have a quick copy?
Ethan Cole: paste the short PO fields into the form but here's the minimal snippet to include in the description:
```
Vendor: <name>
Amount: $XXXX
Budget owner: <manager>
Business justification: <1-2 lines>
Requested by: <name>
```
Priya Nair: Small operational notes: - If a vendor requires a contract, attach the redlined doc. - For SaaS, include expected MRR/annualized run rate. - If external payments to contractors, mark as "consulting" in the form.
FinanceBot: :calendar: Reminder scheduled - "Q3 budget submissions" will ping channels tomorrow at 10:00.
Samir Patel: Thanks - will push the ENG asks into the sheet today.
Lina Gomez: Will product compile a prioritized list of vendors we plan to renew this quarter?
Priya Nair: Yes please - product + eng to send a prioritized list by Wednesday. Finance will run the reforecast model and follow up with teams with any headcount or spend recommendations.
Ethan Cole: One last note: teams with Dedicated pools or committed contracts, we'll only reforecast utilization, not cancel without a 30d notice clause review.
Priya Nair: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. If you have questions DM me or drop them here. :thumbsup:
